page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head centred at the top. No margin notes. No page number printed. Signature-like mark "M.iiij." at the foot, right of centre.

main_text.p: Iustificationem meritis operum nostrorum tribuunt Cathari, Hierachitæ, Meletiani, Donatistæ, Pelagiani, [?]Monachi, Anabaptistæ, Iustitiarij, Operistæ, Papistæ.
Sanctificationem, siue vitæ & spiritus renouationem, dicunt esse resurrectionem carnis Hymenæus, [?]Menandriani.
Vitæ sanctitatem irrident Basilidiani, Carpo-cratiani, Nicolaitæ, Valentiniani, Archontici.
Neminem ad sancte viuendum compellendum esse volunt Donatistæ.
Exercitia pietatis omnia repudiant Aeriani, Iouinianistæ.
main_text.head: In Deum.
main_text.p: Deum numen quoddam unicum esse & solitarium tanquam mundi monarcham unum dicunt Apellitæ, Messaliani, Deitæ, Monarchitæ.

Vnam esse in Trinitate personam, quæ diuersis nominibus, Patris, Filij, & Spiritus sancti appelletur, dicunt Simoniani, Ptolemæi, Colarba-sii, Montanistæ, Noetiani, Praxeani, Sabelliani, A-pollinaristæ, Priscillianistæ.
Trinitatem esse extensionem vnius eiusdem-que rei, vti ceræ, docent [?]Marcelliani.
Personas in Trinitate esse vti vnius lucernæ duo luminaria, Hierachitæ.
Personas esse vti vasa alia in aliis contenta, & pelles in sese implicatas, [?]Metangismonitæ.
Tres personas esse tres Deos diuersos & se-paratos, Tritheitæ, Triformiani.
Personarum quaternitatem constituunt Mar-citæ, Apollinaristæ, Tetratheitæ.

page.notes: Printer's ornament (a small hand-like mark) stands before "Monachi", "Menandriani", "Marcelliani" and "Metangismonitæ" and is not transcribed beyond [?]. The mark at the foot right, "M.iiij.", is uncertain as a signature; it is placed in bottom_margin and also repeated as the last line of main text, as printed. Running head reads APOSTOLORVM, converted to APOSTOLORUM under the u/v rule. Long s is written as plain s throughout. No printing errors were judged certain.
